All three are unit-tested with fixtures, none was seen in a browser. Checkable in one query: select a customer whose customer_contacts has no primary row (or a מ20 feedback with reasons = '{}') and open מ21/מ20 with ?customer=<id> — the cell must read 'אין איש קשר ראשי' / '— ללא הערה', never an empty cell.
